dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. A prominent central annulus features a sharp light-gray outer perimeter transitioning abruptly from the dark-gray base. A larger, irregular posterior 'C' structure exhibits a jagged, high-intensity boundary with a high-gradient transition to its dark interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, light-gray pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily localized in the mid-to-posterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the central circular annulus, the dorsal-most elongated annulus, and the large posterior irregular ring form a scalene triangle. Smaller high-intensity blobs posteriorly form an irregular polygonal cluster relative to these primary rings.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark horizontal skin furrows or folds located in the anterior neck region.
